attempts.why: h1 has 64px font with long word 'Unmistakably' and no wrapping, causing its scrollWidth 412px to overflow the 375px viewport (24+412=436 docScrollWidth) and create horizontal scroll; adding overflow-wrap allows it to wrap within container.

selfVerify.reason: Original bug caused docScrollWidth 436 > viewport 375 due to h1 scrollWidth 412. Now docScrollWidth=375 matches viewport 375x700, h1 box width 327 fits container (24+327=351<375) with wrapped height 384, no horizontal scroll. No other element overflows viewport (max x+w=358 badge, table 658px overflow is contained in .table-wrap with ovf:auto scroll 658x123/client 327x123 - intentional isolated scroll, not document scroll).
